t0010-01.gloss: A field card gives routine soil duties and a personal reminder.
t0010-01.rival_reading: A county worker could receive temporary plot access during an emergency survey; the animal reminder is private and does not establish a malfunction.

t0010-02.gloss: A marked field row and a tool carry different traces.
t0010-02.rival_reading: A response crew could survey a field after access changed and carry a clean tool; the marked row need not belong to a program.
